version.title: Collect the nightly snapshot
version.purpose: Record a dated snapshot of the export directory each night so a missing export is noticed the next morning.

dag.name: job_01K7A5ZQ8M3N4P5R6S7T8V9W01
dag.spec:
type: chain
description: "Collect the nightly snapshot"
group: "txehq/txe"
labels:
  - "txe.schema=1"
  - "txe.owner=own_01K7A5ZQ8M3N4P5R6S7T8V9W0A"
  - "txe.project=prj_00000000000000000000000001"
  - "txe.job=job_01K7A5ZQ8M3N4P5R6S7T8V9W01"
  - "txe.machine=mch_01K7A5ZQ8M3N4P5R6S7T8V9W0C"
  - "txe.version=8"
  - "txe.package=sha256-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
worker_selector:
  txe.machine: "mch_01K7A5ZQ8M3N4P5R6S7T8V9W0C"
schedule: "CRON_TZ=Australia/Perth 0 2 * * *"
overlap_policy: skip
max_active_runs: 1
timeout_sec: 300
working_dir: "/Users/connor/.local/share/txe-dagu/packages/job_01K7A5ZQ8M3N4P5R6S7T8V9W01/sha256-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef/files"
artifacts:
  enabled: true
env:
  - TXE_JOB_ID: "job_01K7A5ZQ8M3N4P5R6S7T8V9W01"
  - TXE_JOB_VERSION: "8"
  - TXE_OUTPUT_DIR: "/Users/connor/.local/share/txe-dagu/outputs/job_01K7A5ZQ8M3N4P5R6S7T8V9W01"
  - TXE_ATTEMPT_ID: "${context.attempt.id}"
  - TXE_QUEUED_AT: "${context.attempt.queued_at}"
  - TXE_RUN_OUTPUT_DIR: "/Users/connor/.local/share/txe-dagu/outputs/job_01K7A5ZQ8M3N4P5R6S7T8V9W01/runs/${DAG_RUN_ID}/attempts/${context.attempt.id}"
  - TXE_DAGU_HOME: "/Users/connor/.local/share/txe-dagu"
  - SOURCE_DIR: "/srv/exports"
secrets:
  - name: LINEAR_API_KEY
    provider: file
    key: "/Users/connor/.config/txe/linear-token"
steps:
  - name: run
    command:
      - "/Users/connor/.local/share/txe-dagu/bin/dagu txe artifacts begin --dagu-home /Users/connor/.local/share/txe-dagu/client"
      - "./collect.py"
      - "/Users/connor/.local/share/txe-dagu/bin/dagu txe artifacts seal --dagu-home /Users/connor/.local/share/txe-dagu/client"
  - name: publish
    command: "/Users/connor/.local/share/txe-dagu/bin/dagu txe artifacts publish --dagu-home /Users/connor/.local/share/txe-dagu/client"

success_criteria: A snapshot file exists for each night.

review_policy.brief: Check that last night's snapshot exists and is not empty.
